EXT.evidence: Speaks briefly with factual remarks and a single “OK,” follows along with the tour, and lets the other person lead the interaction.

AGR.evidence: Cooperative and compliant—checks out the features shown, sits when prompted, and is straightforward without conflict.

CON.evidence: No clear behavior showing organization/efficiency or carelessness.

NEU.evidence: No signs of anxiety, irritation, or emotional reactivity.

OPN.evidence: Provides simple factual observations (office size/shape, window view) without showing curiosity or imaginative engagement.
